items.title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
items.summary: A criminal investigation into the former prince continues and police have retained material seized from his homes.

items.title: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire
items.summary: Police say they apprehended the suspects at about 02:00 while they were inside the perimeter.

items.title: Three sisters who drowned in sea off Brighton took own lives, inquest finds
items.summary: Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters, who lived in London, drowned in the sea in May.

items.title: Royal Navy sailor in court accused of preparing to spy for Russia
items.summary: The 24-year-old man appeared at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Thursday after being arrested at his home in Bedfordshire.

items.title: Asos hackers took more personal details than first revealed, BBC finds
items.summary: Retailer issues update after BBC contacted by cyber criminals who said this week's breach went beyond "basic contact details".

items.title: Death of 12-year-old girl prompts call for allergy management ratings
items.summary: Mia St Hilaire had a tree nut allergy and suffered an anaphylactic shock after drinking a milkshake.

items.title: Forty five Scottish police officers suspended over alleged crimes against women, says chief constable
items.summary: Chief Constable Jo Farrell says more officers are likely to face action as officers are re-vetted.

items.title: Watch: Why was the sign at the British consulate in East Jerusalem removed?
items.summary: The consulate, first established in 1838, was set to be closed by the Israeli government in retaliation for UK sanctions.
